Topics covered in this PDF

BPSE-146 (Conflict Resolution and Peace Building) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Conflict, its life cycle, theories of conflict, new wars
  • Women, Peace and Security agenda, conflict over territory and resources
  • Martin Luther King, Positive Peace, world peace system, Boulding, sources of conflict in South Asia

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: tutor marked assignment, answer all questions, equal weightage, 100 marks
  • Assignment I: questions 1 and 2, about 500 words each, 2 x 20 = 40 marks
  • Assignment II: questions 3 to 5, about 250 words each, 3 x 10 = 30 marks
  • Assignment III: questions 6 to 10, about 100 words each, 5 x 6 = 30 marks

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
